_: Content-free pin of the MECHANICAL PORT check for ui/ceremony/phrase.mjs. The port was verified against the owner's own source with the donor checkout present; these digests record that verification so the check no longer silently evaporates on machines without it. No donor content is stored - digests only.
why: test/ceremony-phrase.test.mjs used a bare `return` when the donor was absent, so on every machine but the owner's it printed SKIPPED and reported ok. A test that cannot run must not report a pass, and it was feeding the anti-drift baseline floor while verifying nothing.
